Hi Alice / Bob —

Thanks again for taking the demo today — appreciate the clear questions on PII and retention. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps: 

What we heard:
- FinTechCorp needs strict handling of user-entered PII (payment identifiers, SSN fragments, unstructured PII)
- Preference for 0-retention (no persistent request logs or embeddings) for the production workspace processing live user data
- Data residency: primary processing & key storage in us-east1
- Audit/logging: procurement/legal may need 90‑day audit logs (separate requirement) but those can be scoped to metadata only

Redwood options we discussed:
- Zero-retention mode: no persistent request logs, no embeddings cached to disk; ephemeral in-memory state only (keeps inference functioning but limits historical debugging)
- Shortened logs: configurable retention windows (7/30/90 days) for request metadata; payload scrubbing available for detected PII
- Separate audit log export: we can ship audit metadata (non-PII) to a customer-managed S3 for 90-day retention if needed

Attachments: SOC2 snapshot attached for your security team.

Next steps (proposed):
1) Technical deep-dive with Neha (SE) to validate zero-retention behavior & tradeoffs — 30 min
2) Legal: share DPA redlines; Camila to provide initial DPA & retention-exception form
3) Security: Rafael to confirm encryption/KMS approach for customer-managed keys (if needed)

Please reply with availability for a tech call tomorrow or Thursday morning PT and any redlines your legal team wants attached to the DPA.

Thanks,
Camila

Thanks, Camila / Alice — looping in details from the SE side. Short version up front: yes — we can support 0-retention for request payloads and embeddings for a production workspace with the following caveats and options: 

Details:
- Zero-retention mode:
  * Request payloads are processed in-memory and not written to persistent logs or object storage.
  * Embeddings and KV caches are not persisted to disk when zero-retention is enabled. All caches are ephemeral (in-memory) and cleared on model restart.
  * This disables some historical observability (token-level cost breakdowns, replay) and will limit time-travel debugging.

- Shortened retention option: configurable retention window (7 / 30 / 90 days) with optional payload scrubbing for detected PII.

- Audit log export: we can export non-PII audit metadata (request timestamps, route id, model id, success/failure) to your S3 with customer-managed encryption. We will exclude request text/payloads from the exported feed.

Tradeoffs / performance notes:
- Zero-retention increases troubleshooting time for incidents and may require additional logging instrumentation (customer-side) for replayable traces.
- Some advanced Optimize features (prompt regression analysis) require persisted examples; those will be disabled for zero-retention workspaces.

Proposal: schedule a 30-min tech call to walk the team through the config and confirm export fields. I've attached a short ops note that lists the exact flags & config steps.

Neha Kapoor
